acceptance.check: Policy regression suite rejects expired, replayed, over-scope and kill-switched capabilities with stable error codes and no mutation executed
acceptance.how_to_verify: Run node --test test/policy/kernel.test.js; all four rejection cases pass and the fake provider records zero writes

acceptance.check: Posting the same capability nonce to the execute endpoint twice performs the provider mutation once and the receipt shows reconciled provider state
acceptance.how_to_verify: Run node --test test/executor/executor.test.js duplicate-delivery case; second delivery returns the original receipt id with executed:false

acceptance.check: With a spend-spike or tracking-loss condition triggered live, every page shows a persistent guardian freeze banner, writes refuse, and the banner clears only after explicit re-enable and re-arms on re-trigger without reseeding
acceptance.how_to_verify: curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/v1/guardian/trigger?kind=spend-spike; load /, /journal and /approvals and confirm the freeze banner on each; POST /v1/guardian/re-enable with an explicit human actor and confirm it clears; POST the trigger again and confirm the banner returns with no reseed

acceptance.check: The approvals page shows autonomy posture per action class with a calibrated low-risk class marked autonomous under micro-limits and new-geography marked shadow or approval-required
acceptance.how_to_verify: Load /approvals on seed data and read the posture table rows

acceptance.check: A failed approval action leaves the item in the pending queue with a reconciliation panel, and a successful approval confirms via a toast naming the receipt id
acceptance.how_to_verify: Load /approvals?meta_error=quota on seed data, approve one item with a reason and confirm the item stays pending with the reconciliation panel visible and no receipt toast; then load /approvals with no param, approve another item and confirm the toast names the receipt id

alternatives_considered.rejected_because: A new runtime dependency for what node:crypto HMAC-SHA256 does in a few lines; conventions require stdlib-first with justification

alternatives_considered.approach: Separate approvals microservice or new SPA for the queue
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Project is a single boring Node monolith with server-rendered pages and no frontend build; a second service or framework contradicts the approved architecture

validated_work_order.approach: Add a deterministic Policy Kernel in src/policy/kernel.js (pure domain, no IO): ActionIntent validation against micro-limits and maturity bands, HMAC-signed capability issuance (tenant, resource, action, constraints, expiry, nonce, policy version), and validation rejecting expired, replayed (nonce store), over-scope and kill-switched capabilities with stable codes. Add kill-switch checks at global, tenant, provider and campaign levels plus a guardian loop (spend-spike and tracking-loss detectors) that freezes automation and records a persistent incident re-enabled only by explicit human action or the deterministic recovery policy. Add a per-action-class trust ledger driving autonomous-under-micro-limits vs approval vs shadow posture. Add the Executor as the sole credential holder executing only valid capabilities against typed Meta adapter writes, idempotent on nonce with provider reconciliation and receipts. Persist capabilities/nonces, approvals, action records, kill switches, trust entries and incidents via a new migration plus repositories; expose approvals/guardian/execute routes; render the real approvals queue and a persistent guardian banner. Answering the rejection: (1) fake.js failure injection extends to the typed WRITE_METHODS so a write under failureMode quota/revoked refuses with the same envelope and zero mutation, the approve/execute POST routes accept ?meta_error=quota|revoked exactly like the GET page routes do today (per-request provider, no cross-request state), and client.js carries the page query param onto the approve POST, so /approvals?meta_error=quota approve exercises the forced-failure path live; (2) POST /v1/guardian/trigger?kind=spend-spike|tracking-loss is the live repeatable freeze trigger sharing the deterministic fixtures the guardian tests use, re-arming after every re-enable with no reseed. Meta Ads only per the binding epic decision; Google Ads reuses this slice later.
assumptions: Seed writes approvals-queue and trust-ledger fixtures only and never activates a guardian freeze; the live freeze comes solely from POST /v1/guardian/trigger, so re-arming never depends on idempotent reseeding
HMAC secret comes from env with a fixed dev default so CI and browser QA verify signatures deterministically
validated_work_order.confidence_rationale: Root cause is greenfield safety code following established repo patterns (pure domain modules, tenant-bound repositories, server-rendered five-state pages); the two rejected points are now wired explicitly (write-path failure injection end to end, repeatable guardian trigger route) instead of assumed.

files.change: Pure domain module: validate ActionIntent (quota/micro-limits, maturity band per action class), issue HMAC-signed capability {tenant, resource, action, constraints, expiry, nonce, policy_version}, validate capability rejecting EXPIRED_CAPABILITY, REPLAYED_NONCE, OVER_SCOPE, KILL_SWITCH_ACTIVE with {code,message,details}; never imports sqlite, providers or credentials

Guardian detectors: spend-spike (observed spend vs baseline over window) and tracking-loss (no qualified events past freshness threshold) evaluate deterministic fixtures shared with the trigger route and tests to freeze decisions; freeze sets provider/tenant kill switch and appends an incident; re-enable only via explicit human call or deterministic recovery predicate, never from strategy input

Per-action-class trust ledger math: score = calibrated success minus false-intervention and downside penalties from decision evaluations; posture thresholds map score to autonomous-under-micro-limits, approval-required or shadow; new-geography class pinned to shadow/approval until its own evidence accrues

Executor service: sole module allowed to hold mutation credentials; validates capability via kernel, dedupes on nonce (second delivery returns original receipt), accepts an injected provider so routes can pass a failureMode-scoped fake, calls typed provider writes, reconciles provider-reported state, records receipt plus drift (manual/platform/third-party) and audit event with actor and capability id

Add migration 005_safety_tables: capabilities/nonces (tenant, nonce PK, expiry, scope hash), approvals (tenant, approval_id PK, intent, impact/downside/evidence/expiry, status pending/approved/rejected/lapsed/executed, reason, receipt), action_records (tenant, receipt PK, nonce unique, reconciliation), kill_switches (scope PK global/tenant/provider/campaign, active, actor, reason), trust_ledger (tenant, action_class PK, score, posture), guardian_incidents (tenant, incident PK, kind, frozen_at, re-enabled) with append-only triggers on receipts/incidents

Add tenant-bound repositories for approvals, nonces/capabilities, action records, kill switches, trust ledger and guardian incidents; every query binds tenant_id; no update/delete on append-only tables
Add typed write interface WRITE_METHODS (updateBudget, setCampaignStatus, createDraft) with row/envelope validation mirroring the read contract; no version or error-code redefinition

Implement typed writes against in-memory fixture state keyed by capability nonce: duplicate nonce returns the stored receipt without re-applying; expose reconcile read returning provider-reported state; extend failure injection to writes so failureMode quota/revoked refuses every WRITE_METHOD with the same META_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED/META_PERMISSION_REVOKED envelope as reads and mutates nothing

Add routes GET/POST /v1/approvals (list, request), POST /v1/approvals/:id/approve and /reject (reason required, failure keeps pending with reconciliation state; both accept ?meta_error=quota|revoked and build the executor provider with that failureMode per request exactly like the GET page routes), POST /v1/actions/execute (capability envelope, idempotent on nonce, accepts ?meta_error the same way), GET /v1/guardian (freeze status and incidents), POST /v1/guardian/trigger?kind=spend-spike|tracking-loss (live repeatable freeze writing the kill-switch row plus an incident, re-arms after every re-enable with no reseed) and POST /v1/guardian/re-enable (explicit human actor); kill-switch violations return 409 with stable codes in the {code,message} envelope; GET page routes pass guardian freeze state into renderPage

Approvals page reads the approvals repository: pending queue cards with impact, downside, evidence refs and expiry; approve/reject forms with reason field; executed receipts section; lapsed section for expired items (partial state); error shell keeps item pending with reconciliation copy 'Approval action failed (check: reconciliation). The item stays pending and nothing was executed.'; empty state keeps autonomy-posture table now rendered from the trust ledger. Add persistent guardian freeze banner ([data-testid=guardian-banner], role=status, copy 'Automation is frozen — <kind> guard tripped. Writes are refused until a human re-enables.') to layout on every page while any kill switch is active; approve buttons keyboard-operable with focus and live-region announcements; success toast copy 'Approved — receipt <id>'

Wire approve/reject buttons to fetch POST with reason, carrying the page URL ?meta_error param onto the POST URL when present so /approvals?meta_error=quota drives the forced-failure path; success toast names the receipt id, failure path keeps the card pending and announces reconciliation state via the live region; keep under 100-line vanilla style, DOM textContent only for stored data

Extend seed through the repository layer only: one pending approval fixture with impact/downside/evidence/expiry, one executed receipt fixture, trust-ledger baseline rows (one calibrated low-risk class, new-geography pinned shadow); never writes an active guardian freeze or kill-switch row — the live freeze comes from POST /v1/guardian/trigger; idempotent on fixed ids

out_of_scope: Google Ads adapter (later epic reuses this kernel per binding decision)

risks: Touches money movement, auth-equivalent capabilities and credential isolation: review must confirm no module outside src/executor imports mutation credentials or the HMAC secret
Kill-switch and guardian tables are new shared state: migration must stay additive and idempotent on existing databases
Fake-provider writes are test/simulation only; live.js must not gain real mutation calls beyond the typed interface in this slice

cases: expired capability rejects with EXPIRED_CAPABILITY
replayed nonce rejects with REPLAYED_NONCE and executes nothing
over-scope action rejects with OVER_SCOPE naming the violated constraint
capability under an active kill switch (each of global, tenant, provider, campaign) rejects with KILL_SWITCH_ACTIVE
valid capability verifies and issues the signed envelope with all seven fields
spend-spike fixture freezes automation and records a persistent incident
tracking-loss fixture freezes automation and records a persistent incident
re-enable requires explicit human actor or the deterministic recovery predicate
writes refuse while frozen; read-only research paths keep serving
POST /v1/guardian/trigger re-arms the freeze after a re-enable with no reseed
duplicate delivery of the same nonce executes exactly once against the fake provider
receipt carries reconciliation against provider-reported state
drift between requested and reported state is detected and recorded
manual/platform/third-party drift scenario writes a drift record
write under failureMode quota refuses with META_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED and mutates nothing
repeated safe outcomes raise the class posture to autonomous under micro-limits
one bad outcome collapses only that class, others unaffected
new-geography class stays in shadow or approval without its own evidence
approve transitions pending to executed with receipt id in response
reject requires reason and records actor
approval failure via ?meta_error=quota keeps the item pending with reconciliation state
expired approvals surface as lapsed, never vanish

validated_work_order.understanding: Issue #20 is the safety slice of epic #14: every external write must flow ActionIntent to deterministic Policy Kernel to signed capability (tenant, resource, action, constraints, expiry, nonce, policy version) to Executor validation, with kill switches at global/tenant/provider/campaign levels, a per-action-class trust ledger, and an approvals queue plus guardian freeze UI. Nothing of this exists yet: the repo has the decision journal, measurement, Meta read adapter and fake provider, but no policy kernel, executor, approvals, kill switches, guardian or trust ledger. Binding decision: Meta Ads first, Google Ads later, so writes target the Meta adapter seam only.
